title: Parihānaṃ
text: 1--2. Pāṭaliputte viharanti Kukkuṭārāme || || 3. Ko nu kho āvuso Ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti || ko nu kho āvuso Ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhamma-aparihānaṃ hetu || || Sādhu sādhu āvuso Bhadda || bhaddhako kho te āvuso Bhadda ummaggo bhaddakam paṭibhānaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā || evaṃ hi tvam āvuso Bhadda pucchasi || Ko nu āvuso hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti || ko panāvuso Ānanda hetu ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṃ hoti ti || || Evam āvuso ti || || 4. Catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti || catunnaṃ ca kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhamma-aparihānaṃ hoti || katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || 5. Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti || imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhamma-aparihānaṃ hotī ti || ||
